options.content: Pilots: Live now · Traffic · New pilots · Origins · Records · **Routes** · Aircraft · Military | ATC: Overview · Retention · Hours · Positions · Ranks | Events: Live events · Monday events | Management: Health All times are UTC. Figures cover VATPAC airspace. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position; a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight). Each panel has a fixed period and a fixed number of rows, stated in its title and description; the page has no inputs. Airports means home-region airports (code starting with Y by default).

panels.title: Most popular domestic routes (last 30 days)
panels.description: Question B1 (v1 card 97), copied unchanged from Pilots: traffic and aircraft. Definition: most popular routes over the last 30 days with both ends in the home region. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT route_label AS route, departure, arrival, count(*) AS flights, count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.departure <> f.arrival
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
  AND f.dep_is_home AND f.arr_is_home
GROUP BY route_label, departure, arrival
ORDER BY flights DESC, route
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Most popular international routes (last 30 days)
panels.description: Question B2 (v1 card 45), copied unchanged from Pilots: traffic and aircraft. Definition: most popular routes over the last 30 days with at least one end outside the home region. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT route_label AS route, departure, arrival, count(*) AS flights, count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.departure <> f.arrival
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
  AND NOT (f.dep_is_home AND f.arr_is_home)
GROUP BY route_label, departure, arrival
ORDER BY flights DESC, route
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Most popular VFR routes (last 30 days)
panels.description: Question B3 (v1 card 59), copied unchanged from Pilots: traffic and aircraft. Definition: most popular VFR routes over the last 30 days, flown by at least 3 pilots. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT route_label AS route,
       count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots,
       count(*) AS flights,
       round(avg(duration_minutes)::numeric, 1) AS "Average duration (min)",
       min(end_time) AS "First flight",
       max(end_time) AS "Latest flight"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND f.flight_rules = 'V'
  AND f.departure <> f.arrival
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
GROUP BY route_label
HAVING count(DISTINCT cid) >= 3
ORDER BY pilots DESC, flights DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Busiest home-region airports (last 30 days)
panels.description: Question B4 (v1 card 55), copied unchanged from Pilots: traffic and aircraft. Definition: busiest home-region airports by departures and arrivals over the last 30 days. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT airport,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE movement_type = 'departure') AS departures,
       count(*) FILTER (WHERE movement_type = 'arrival') AS arrivals
FROM movements
WHERE movement_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY airport
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, airport
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Airports with the most departures (last 30 days, top 10)
panels.description: Question B5 (new). Definition: the ten Australian airports (ICAO code starts with Y) with the most departures among flights that started in the last 30 days (UTC, ending now), by departure time. Flights with airborne time only (a parked flight, with none, is not counted); flights to or from ZZZZ are left out; a circuit counts as one departure and one arrival; ties by airport code. Airports outside the home region are not listed. Australian airports means ICAO code starts with the configured home prefix, currently Y. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.departure AS "Airport", count(*) AS "Departures"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.start_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
  AND f.dep_is_home
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
GROUP BY f.departure
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, f.departure
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Airports with the most arrivals (last 30 days, top 10)
panels.description: Question B6 (new). Definition: the ten Australian airports (ICAO code starts with Y) with the most arrivals among flights that finished in the last 30 days (UTC, ending now), by arrival time. Flights with airborne time only; flights to or from ZZZZ are left out; ties by airport code. Airports outside the home region are not listed. Australian airports means ICAO code starts with the configured home prefix, currently Y. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.arrival AS "Airport", count(*) AS "Arrivals"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
  AND f.arr_is_home
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
GROUP BY f.arrival
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, f.arrival
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Busiest airports, departures plus arrivals (rolling last 24 hours, top 10)
panels.description: Question B10 (new). Definition: the ten Australian airports (ICAO code starts with Y) with the most movements (departures counted at flight start, arrivals at flight end) in the 24 hours ending now. Flights with airborne time only; flights to or from ZZZZ are left out; ties by airport code. A flight appears only about 8 hours after the pilot's last position, so the most recent hours are incomplete and a quiet or empty table does not mean a quiet airport. Australian airports means ICAO code starts with the configured home prefix, currently Y. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.airport AS "Airport", sum(m.dep) + sum(m.arr) AS "Movements", sum(m.dep) AS "Departures", sum(m.arr) AS "Arrivals"
FROM (
  SELECT f.departure AS airport, 1 AS dep, 0 AS arr FROM flight_ext f
  WHERE f.start_time >= now() - interval '24 hours'
    AND f.airborne_minutes > 0 AND f.dep_is_home AND NOT f.is_zzzz
  UNION ALL
  SELECT f.arrival, 0, 1 FROM flight_ext f
  WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '24 hours'
    AND f.airborne_minutes > 0 AND f.arr_is_home AND NOT f.is_zzzz
) m
GROUP BY m.airport
ORDER BY sum(m.dep) + sum(m.arr) DESC, m.airport
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Busiest airports, departures plus arrivals (rolling last 7 days, top 10)
panels.description: Question B10 (new). Definition: the ten Australian airports (ICAO code starts with Y) with the most movements (departures counted at flight start, arrivals at flight end) in the 7 days ending now. Flights with airborne time only; flights to or from ZZZZ are left out; ties by airport code. The last few hours are incomplete because a flight appears about 8 hours after the pilot's last position. Australian airports means ICAO code starts with the configured home prefix, currently Y. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT m.airport AS "Airport", sum(m.dep) + sum(m.arr) AS "Movements", sum(m.dep) AS "Departures", sum(m.arr) AS "Arrivals"
FROM (
  SELECT f.departure AS airport, 1 AS dep, 0 AS arr FROM flight_ext f
  WHERE f.start_time >= now() - interval '7 days'
    AND f.airborne_minutes > 0 AND f.dep_is_home AND NOT f.is_zzzz
  UNION ALL
  SELECT f.arrival, 0, 1 FROM flight_ext f
  WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '7 days'
    AND f.airborne_minutes > 0 AND f.arr_is_home AND NOT f.is_zzzz
) m
GROUP BY m.airport
ORDER BY sum(m.dep) + sum(m.arr) DESC, m.airport
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Australian airports with the most international arrivals (last 30 days, top 10)
panels.description: Question B8 (new). Definition: the ten Australian airports (ICAO code starts with Y) with the most international arrivals among flights that finished in the last 30 days (UTC, ending now). An international arrival is a flight that lands at an Australian airport after departing from an airport whose code does not start with Y. Flights with airborne time only; flights to or from ZZZZ are left out; ties by airport code. Flights between two Australian airports (ICAO code starts with Y), and flights leaving Australia, are not counted. Australian here means the ICAO code starts with Y; it has nothing to do with the pilot's own home airport. Australian airports means ICAO code starts with the configured home prefix, currently Y. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT f.arrival AS "Airport", count(*) AS "International arrivals", count(DISTINCT f.cid) AS "Pilots"
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time >= now() - interval '30 days'
  AND f.airborne_minutes > 0
  AND f.departure IS NOT NULL
  AND f.arr_is_home
  AND NOT f.dep_is_home
  AND NOT f.is_zzzz
GROUP BY f.arrival
ORDER BY count(*) DESC, f.arrival
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Where pilots currently online come from
panels.description: Question B9 (v1 card 99), copied unchanged from Demographics: pilot origins and cohorts. Definition: home region of the pilots online now. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT region, count(DISTINCT cid) AS pilots
FROM pilot_online_now
GROUP BY region
ORDER BY pilots DESC

panels.title: Who flies most in Australian airspace: flights by home region (last 30 days)
panels.description: Question B9 (v1 card 100), copied unchanged from Demographics: pilot origins and cohorts. Definition: flights per pilot home region over the last 30 days. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pilot_region AS region, count(*) AS flights
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY pilot_region
ORDER BY flights DESC

panels.title: Who spends most time in Australian airspace: airborne hours by home region (last 30 days)
panels.description: Question B9 (v1 card 101), copied unchanged from Demographics: pilot origins and cohorts. Definition: airborne hours per pilot home region over the last 30 days. A flight is counted once it has finished (about 8 hours after the pilot's last position); a reconnect within 2 hours on the same flight is one flight. Times are UTC.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT pilot_region AS region, round((sum(airborne_minutes) / 60.0)::numeric, 1) AS hours
FROM flight_ext f
WHERE f.end_time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND airborne_minutes > 0
GROUP BY pilot_region
ORDER BY hours DESC
